# Jin AI

> Jin spots repetitive tasks, prepares the work, and learns from your team's feedback.

Status: Building. Last updated: 2026-10-27.
Jin AI is in private beta. We are working through the waitlist.

Live means available now. Building means active development. Next means intended next work. Never present Building or Next as shipped. The Human pages listed under Pages are canonical; the English home page at https://jinai.md/ is the primary product page. Agent-facing formats are derivatives generated from the structured JSON fact source.

For Teams that already use AI tools but still do repetitive work by hand.

## AI harness

An AI harness is the instructions, skills, memory and connected tools around an AI agent that make it work for a role.

## Direct answers

- [What is Jin AI?](https://jinai.md/agent/#what-is-jin-ai): Jin spots repetitive tasks, prepares the work, and learns from your team's feedback.
- [What is an AI harness?](https://jinai.md/agent/#what-is-an-ai-harness): An AI harness is the instructions, skills, memory and connected tools around an AI agent that make it work for a role.
- [Is Jin AI available now?](https://jinai.md/agent/#is-jin-ai-available): Jin AI is in private beta. We are working through the waitlist.
- [Which AI tools does it work with?](https://jinai.md/agent/#which-ai-tools-does-it-work-with): Claude Code first. Other AI tools are next.
- [Where does the data live?](https://jinai.md/agent/#where-does-the-data-live): Jin AI keeps each company's data separate. What Jin reads is used only to prepare work for that person and is never used to train AI models.
- [How is this different from banning AI tools?](https://jinai.md/agent/#how-is-this-different-from-banning-ai-tools): Banning AI tools also removes the harnesses that work. Jin AI keeps confidential data in and lets the company reuse what works.

## Problem

AI is there. Using it is still their job.

## Solution (Building)

Don't ask AI. Jin AI prepares it before anyone asks, right when you need it.

One person's improvement is reviewed, then applied to the relevant people.

## Jin learns how your team works. (Building)

- Connect your tools: Jin connects to the apps your team already uses. Admins manage which tools and MCP servers employees connect, all in one place.
- Spot repetitive work: Jin finds the tasks each employee does again and again.
- Get the work ready: Jin doesn't just suggest an automation. It runs it in a sandbox and shows the finished output. Nothing changes until the employee approves it.
- Share what works: Automations that work are offered to people doing similar work. Your company can also build organization skills that everyone can use.

## How it works and status

Connect once, see every part, and Jin AI keeps each team's shared harness up to date.

- Connect once: Connect your usual AI tools once, through MCP.
- See every part by type: Skills, prompts, memory and MCP settings, sorted by type.
- See what each team uses most: See which harnesses each department uses most.
- Separate personal from company: Keep what came from personal AI apart from parts that hold confidential company context.
- Control approved AI tools: Let people use only the tools you approve. For example: Claude Code for developers only, your company policy in Copilot, and only non-confidential parts in ChatGPT.

- Workspace beta (Live)
- Connect once (Building): Jin AI connects to your AI tools through MCP. Claude Code first.
- See every harness by category (Building): Skills, instructions, memory and MCP settings, sorted for each person.
- See it by role (Next): Which harnesses each role uses, and how often.
- Decide what can move (Next): Parts marked confidential connect only to the AI tools you approve.

## Single control plane for what can be accessed.

Jin only accesses information your company has approved. Your employees can see what Jin used, review what it prepared, and decide what happens next.

It is never used to train AI models.
